table.name: TLGNS_SAP_MATERIAL_SAREA
table.description: Material Sales Area Data received from SAP. The sales area from SAP is only partially defined (Sales Org + Distribution Channel). The Division will only be known when material is used, e.g. based on Contract information.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_SAREA_ID
column.description: PK. Technical key, given by Logon.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The Material in this Material Sales Area Data.

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sorg_bs. The Sales Organisation for which this material-sales-area is defined for. E.g. S101, S128, S160, ... SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / VKORG

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
column.description: The Distribution Channel for which this material-sales-area is defined for, e.g. 10=Domestic, 20=Export. SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / VTWEG

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP. SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / LVORM. 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: SALES_UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. The sales unit (of measure). SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / VRKME, must match with the Logon reference data table.

column.name: PRICING_GROUP
column.description: The material pricing group. A way of grouping materials to which apply the same conditions. Used for resolving generic materials into real materials in case the generic material groups by Material pricing group. SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / KONDM

column.name: MATERIAL_GROUP4
column.description: The generic material is indicated by having the values (1,2) in material group4. This value also indicates the grouping criterion (either division='1' or material pricing group = '2'). SAP: material_sales_data (E1MVKEM) / MVGR4

column.name: IS_GENERIC_FLAG
column.description: Technical flag for easier filtering. Is set if the material group4 defines the material as a generic material. 1=Generic Material, 0=Real Material
